top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
top_sast_rules.description: Replacing a substring with itself has no effect and may indicate a mistake.

top_sast_rules.remediation: Use context-appropriate encoding for all output. Implement proper encoding libraries for HTML, JavaScript, URL, and CSS contexts.

top_sast_rules.description: Deserializing user-controlled data may allow attackers to execute arbitrary code.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Identify deserialization operations on untrusted data without proper validation
top_sast_rules.remediation: Use safe serialization formats like JSON. If complex deserialization is needed, implement strict validation and type checking.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in a Command ('Command Injection')
top_sast_rules.description: Externally influenced data changes the syntax or meaning of a command sent to a downstream command interpreter.
